newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Index maintains fall on Lithuanian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Index maintains fall on Lithuanian bourse.

text.p: The main index on Lithuania's bourse maintained its fall amid a relatively dull day of trading, dealers said.
Traders said news of Russian President Boris Yeltsin's heart operation today had little impact.
Central market volume was 396,000 litas and the group A index, which covers the 22 most active shares on the central market, slid 125.25 points to 1,444.45.
Dealers said a 13.60 percent drop in the shares of Lithuanian Gas to 1.08 litas was again the reason for the slide.
"There was lots of demand for Lithuanian Gas shares earlier this year but no supply, so its price reached an artificially high level," said one dealer.
"Now supply and demand are closer and so its price is falling," the dealer said.
Traders said the market was sanguine over Yeltsin's heart operation.
"The Lithuanian market responds to local political and economic developments but seldom to international ones," said one dealer.
The Birzhu dairy, which recently launched a $6.0 million international share offer, rose 2.22 percent to 4.60 litas on trade of 50,240 litas.
There were also three bloc trades on Tuesday worth 566,000 litas. In the biggest, over 317,000 litas worth of Hermis Bank shares changed hands.
